slots.title: Home: new-here starter kit
where: / signed out → components/home/front-page.tsx NewbieStrip, left end of the 'New here? Everyone starts with $10,000' strip; hidden on phones
slots.crop: The kit fills the frame edge to edge with little padding (the strip is only ~88px tall); centred, wider than tall.
slots.lighting: neutral, soft top-left key; warm paper tones
slots.fallback: Soft blue radial glow with halftone dots, same size; the strip text and buttons still render.
slots.brief: A starter kit laid out like a gift, three-quarter view: a fat stack of play-money bills in a paper band stamped with a hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) diamond, a blank lanyard trader badge draped over it, and a tiny ticker screen propped beside it showing a single blue up-arrow. Two small sparkles. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading, clean dark outline, white and blue with warm paper tones.
slots.notes: No numbers on the bills. Same welcome-kit props as site-auth-pitch (banded bills with the diamond stamp, blank lanyard badge).
